SELECT inventory_live_stock_company_summaries.projection_state, inventory_live_stock_company_summaries.projection_version, inventory_live_stock_company_summaries.active_variant_count, inventory_live_stock_warehouse_summaries.projection_state AS projection_state_1, inventory_live_stock_warehouse_summaries.projection_version AS projection_version_1, inventory_live_stock_warehouse_summaries.alert_count, inventory_live_stock_warehouse_summaries.nonactive_visible_count, CAST(timezone(companies.timezone, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS company_local_date, EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM inventory_live_stock_projection 
WHERE inventory_live_stock_projection.company_id = $1::INTEGER AND inventory_live_stock_projection.warehouse_location_id = $2::INTEGER AND inventory_live_stock_projection.next_transition_date IS NOT NULL AND inventory_live_stock_projection.next_transition_date <= CAST(timezone(companies.timezone, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS DATE)) AS has_due_transition 
FROM inventory_live_stock_company_summaries JOIN inventory_live_stock_warehouse_summaries ON inventory_live_stock_warehouse_summaries.company_id = inventory_live_stock_company_summaries.company_id AND inventory_live_stock_warehouse_summaries.warehouse_location_id = $3::INTEGER JOIN inventory_locations ON inventory_locations.company_id = inventory_live_stock_company_summaries.company_id AND inventory_locations.id = $4::INTEGER AND inventory_locations.location_type = $5::VARCHAR AND inventory_locations.is_active IS true JOIN companies ON companies.id = $6::INTEGER 
WHERE inventory_live_stock_company_summaries.company_id = $7::INTEGER

Plans.Filter: ((next_transition_date IS NOT NULL) AND (company_id = 38) AND (warehouse_location_id = 119) AND (next_transition_date <= (timezone((companies.timezone)::text, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))::date))

SELECT visible_inventory_fast_candidates.id, visible_inventory_fast_candidates.variant_name 
FROM ((SELECT product_variants.id AS id, product_variants.name AS variant_name 
FROM product_variants 
WHERE product_variants.company_id = $1::INTEGER AND product_variants.lifecycle_status = $2::VARCHAR ORDER BY product_variants.name, product_variants.id 
 LIMIT $3::INTEGER) UNION ALL (SELECT inventory_live_stock_projection.product_variant_id AS id, inventory_live_stock_projection.variant_name AS variant_name 
FROM inventory_live_stock_projection 
WHERE inventory_live_stock_projection.company_id = $4::INTEGER AND inventory_live_stock_projection.warehouse_location_id = $5::INTEGER AND inventory_live_stock_projection.lifecycle_status != $6::VARCHAR AND (inventory_live_stock_projection.has_warehouse_presence IS true OR inventory_live_stock_projection.has_vehicle_presence IS true) ORDER BY inventory_live_stock_projection.variant_name, inventory_live_stock_projection.product_variant_id 
 LIMIT $7::INTEGER)) AS visible_inventory_fast_candidates ORDER BY visible_inventory_fast_candidates.variant_name, visible_inventory_fast_candidates.id 
 LIMIT $8::INTEGER

SELECT product_variants.id AS variant_id, product_variants.name AS variant_name, product_variants.sku AS sku, product_variants.base_uom_id AS base_uom_id, product_variants.quantity_scale AS quantity_scale, product_variants.quantity_step AS quantity_step, product_variants.lifecycle_status AS lifecycle_status, product_variants.operational_hold AS operational_hold, uom.code AS base_uom_code, uom.name AS base_uom_name, inventory_live_stock_projection.warehouse_on_hand AS warehouse_on_hand, inventory_live_stock_projection.warehouse_reserved AS warehouse_reserved, inventory_live_stock_projection.warehouse_sellable_on_hand AS warehouse_sellable_on_hand, inventory_live_stock_projection.warehouse_sellable_reserved AS warehouse_sellable_reserved, inventory_live_stock_projection.blocked_status_packs AS blocked_status_packs, inventory_live_stock_projection.recalled_packs AS recalled_packs, inventory_live_stock_projection.damaged_packs AS damaged_packs, inventory_live_stock_projection.vehicle_packs AS projected_vehicle_packs, inventory_live_stock_projection.minimum_quantity AS minimum_quantity, inventory_cost_states.average_unit_cost AS average_unit_cost, companies.currency_code AS currency_code, inventory_latest_purchase_one.last_purchase_cost, inventory_latest_purchase_one.last_purchase_uom_code, inventory_latest_purchase_one.last_purchase_created_at, inventory_display_uom_one.candidate_count, inventory_display_uom_one.display_uom_id_raw, inventory_display_uom_one.display_uom_code_raw, inventory_display_uom_one.display_uom_name_raw, inventory_display_uom_one.display_factor_to_base_raw 
FROM unnest($1::INTEGER[]) AS inventory_detail_keys(product_variant_id) JOIN product_variants ON product_variants.company_id = $2::INTEGER AND product_variants.id = inventory_detail_keys.product_variant_id JOIN uom ON uom.id = product_variants.base_uom_id JOIN companies ON companies.id = product_variants.company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN inventory_live_stock_projection ON inventory_live_stock_projection.company_id = product_variants.company_id AND inventory_live_stock_projection.product_variant_id = product_variants.id AND inventory_live_stock_projection.warehouse_location_id = $3::INTEGER LEFT OUTER JOIN inventory_cost_states ON inventory_cost_states.company_id = product_variants.company_id AND inventory_cost_states.product_variant_id = product_variants.id LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT inventory_cost_events.input_unit_cost AS last_purchase_cost, inventory_latest_purchase_uom.code AS last_purchase_uom_code, inventory_cost_events.created_at AS last_purchase_created_at 
FROM inventory_cost_events JOIN uom AS inventory_latest_purchase_uom ON inventory_latest_purchase_uom.id = inventory_cost_events.input_uom_id 
WHERE inventory_cost_events.company_id = $4::INTEGER AND inventory_cost_events.product_variant_id = product_variants.id AND inventory_cost_events.event_type = $5::VARCHAR ORDER BY inventory_cost_events.created_at DESC, inventory_cost_events.id DESC 
 LIMIT $6::INTEGER) AS inventory_latest_purchase_one ON true LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(product_uom_conversions.id) AS candidate_count, min(inventory_display_uom.id) AS display_uom_id_raw, min(inventory_display_uom.code) AS display_uom_code_raw, min(inventory_display_uom.name) AS display_uom_name_raw, min(product_uom_conversions.numerator / CAST(product_uom_conversions.denominator AS NUMERIC(20, 6))) AS display_factor_to_base_raw 
FROM product_uom_conversions JOIN uom AS inventory_display_uom ON inventory_display_uom.id = product_uom_conversions.from_uom_id 
WHERE product_uom_conversions.company_id = $7::INTEGER AND product_uom_conversions.product_variant_id = product_variants.id AND product_uom_conversions.to_uom_id = product_variants.base_uom_id AND product_uom_conversions.numerator > product_uom_conversions.denominator) AS inventory_display_uom_one ON true ORDER BY product_variants.name, product_variants.id
